en.sayed-ali-raza: [A part of the same sermon :] This path is the lightest course and the brightest lamp.
Guidance towards virtuous actions is sought through faith while guidance towards faith is achieved through virtuous actions.
Knowledge is made to prosper through faith, and death is feared because of knowledge.
This world comes to an end with death, while the next world is secured (by virtuous actions) in this world.
For people there is no escape from resurrection. They are heading for this last end in its appointed course.
